sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We targeted the TP53 locus in Homo sapiens (GRCh38, chr17:7676594-7676613) using SpCas9 (variant eSpCas9). The guide RNA sequence was GGCGCCATCTACAAGCAGTC on strand Watson. The PAM motif was NGG. Guides were designed with CRISPOR. Ribonucleoprotein complexes were delivered by electroporation into HEK293T cells (RRID:CVCL_0063). Cells were grown in DMEM with 10% FBS at 37 °C. A non-targeting sgRNA was included. Editing was measured by amplicon NGS at 72 hours after delivery (n = 3 biological replicates). Off-target analysis used GUIDE-seq; 8 nominated off-target sites were assayed. Single-cell clones were isolated after puromycin selection. Reported editing efficiency was 64%. The Cas9 plasmid was Addgene 62988. A p53 antibody (RRID:AB_331743) confirmed protein loss. Statistics used Student's t-test. Clones were karyotyped.
